name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY) - Integrated with AB PM-JAY (Maharashtra)
benefit: Universal cashless health coverage of Rs 5,00,000 per family per year (family floater) for secondary and tertiary hospitalization, integrated with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY and implemented in expanded form from 1 July 2024. Covers 1,356 medical/surgical procedures across 34 specialties plus follow-up packages, in ~1,900 empanelled government and private hospitals. Includes bed/nursing/boarding charges, surgeon and anesthetist fees, OT and ICU charges, drugs, implants, diagnostics, blood transfusion, food for the inpatient and one-time transport cost. Pre-existing diseases covered from day one; emergency treatment can be initiated via telephonic intimation; premium fully paid by the government.
eligibility_rules: The scheme is UNIVERSAL for Maharashtra: all families resident/domiciled in Maharashtra are covered (per GR dated 28/07/2023, effective 01/07/2024)
Families holding any ration card qualify: Yellow, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Annapurna, Orange, or White ration card (including government/semi-government employees)
Families without any ration card qualify with a Maharashtra domicile certificate

Special covered groups: children in government orphanages, students of government Ashram Shalas, female inmates of government Mahila Ashrams, senior citizens in government old-age homes, DGIPR-approved journalists and their families, and construction workers registered with the Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Families in the SECC 2011 / AB PM-JAY lists get the integrated central+state coverage (cost shared 60:40 by centre and state)
exclusions: Persons not resident/domiciled in Maharashtra are not covered under MJPJAY (though AB PM-JAY benefits are portable nationally for PM-JAY beneficiaries)
Only treatment at empanelled network hospitals is cashless; non-empanelled hospitals are not covered
Certain reserved procedures can only be performed at government hospitals (not private empanelled ones)
Ambulance charges are generally not included
Outpatient (OPD) treatment not requiring hospitalization is not covered under the hospitalization benefit
documents_required: Any valid ration card (Yellow / AAY / Annapurna / Orange / White) OR Maharashtra domicile certificate if no ration card
Photo identity proof: Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Driving license / Passport
Category-specific ID where applicable (e.g. construction worker registration, journalist accreditation)
how_to_apply: Visit any empanelled network hospital or District/Women/General hospital, where an Arogya Mitra (scheme facilitator) verifies eligibility, helps with document submission and gets the MJPJAY/Ayushman health card issued. In emergencies, treatment can start with telephonic intimation. Helpline: 155388 / 1800-233-2200; portal: jeevandayee.gov.in.
source_document: Zilla Parishad (Palghar/Dharashiv) official scheme pages; Maharashtra GR dated 28/07/2023 (universal coverage from 01/07/2024); jeevandayee.gov.in
